model: label-noise scenario envelope, not an error model: flip rate drawn as Normal(mean, sd=0.02), clipped at 0; 4000 draws per scenario; seed 7. Scenario "symmetric" flips strong/non-strong labels at random in either direction (null-attenuating), with the rate centered on the coders' overall bucket error rate vs the released labels. Scenario "strong_to_weak" flips strong labels to weak only, with the rate centered on the strong-label-specific recode rate (each coder recoded 8 of the 13 strong-labelled sample papers weak). Because the coders worked from abstracts under a declared "weak if unreported" fallback, that rate is an upper bound on plausible label error, so "strong_to_weak" is a worst-case bound, not an estimate.
